description: Rossi (P5, Lupine Scarlet, MI Security: the gear of fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json) with Gilberta (that log's build) vs Rhodagn, rolled crits (Lupine Scarlet, MI Security and talent 2 need them). Gilberta's battle skill inflicts Nature; Rossi's battle skill Lifts the enemy (its first Vulnerable stack: no Wolven Ambrage), which with the Nature Infliction opens her combo: sequence 1, then sequence 2 at once (the late path: it consumes the Nature stacks for (3.45 + 2.07 × stacks) × ATK, Lifts, and gives Crit Rate +25% / Crit DMG +50% for 15 s). Her second battle skill finds Vulnerable: the Wolven Ambrage applies Razor Clawmark (talent 1: 0.30 × ATK per second for 25 s, Physical and Heat DMG Taken +12%), whose crit hits from her skills add talent 2's Heat hit. The ultimate's last slash inflicts Heat. Basic-attack chains between.
